mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 0.3% in three months signals weakening labor market confidence, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns despite UNRATE crossing above 0.3% in the trigger period, or the rate rise is not sustained beyond the initial month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both production (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) proxies indicates robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and HOUST does not occur or the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle characterized by rising federal funds rates, investors anticipate higher inflation, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive during the tightening cycle despite rising FEDFUNDS rates, or the regime is not correctly identified by FEDFUNDS trends.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects stronger production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns, or the supply index peaks without sustained upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: When the supply index (INDPRO) exceeds 105, signaling potential overheating in production, investors anticipate inflationary pressures, leading to reduced S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive despite INDPRO crossing above 105, or the index does not sustain the level beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in the labor market (falling UNRATE) coupled with rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity values, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not occur or the 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint movement.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by high employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE), investors anticipate peak growth and profit margins, leading to reduced S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive during the late-cycle expansion regime despite high PAYEMS and low UNRATE, or the regime is not correctly identified by the series trends.
